gasFeesHero.description: In DEEPROOTS, gas fees aren't a barrier — they're a gateway to affordable blockchain access.

sections.title: Gas Fees — Powering DeWorld for Everyone
body: We believe access to the blockchain should be affordable, predictable, and fair.
That's why our gas fees are fixed at just 0.0002 — no spikes, no surprises, no limits to what you can build or use.

grid.title: Ultra Low-Cost
grid.desc: Anyone can transact, no matter their wallet size

grid.title: Fair & Transparent
grid.desc: No sudden surges or hidden costs

grid.title: Easy for Builders
grid.desc: Deploy and scale without worrying about fees

grid.title: Frictionless UX
grid.desc: One price, across every smart contract, game, or app

grid.title: Encourages Growth
grid.desc: More users, more actions, more possibilities

sections.title: How It Works
list: Applies across the entire DeWorld ecosystem
Collected in dRC, your native token
Fuels smart contracts, staking, NFTs, trading, and more
Redirected to support rewards, seeding, and foundation income

sections.title: Built for the Future
body: While other chains compete over gas mechanics, DEEPROOTS keeps it simple, stable, and user-first.
You focus on creating. We keep it moving.

sections.title: No Burn. No Waste.
body: In our first stage, there's no token burning — only circulation, utility, and fair redistribution.
sections.specialBox: Every gas fee flows back into the ecosystem — powering rewards, projects, and long-term sustainability

cta.title: Ready for Fair, Predictable Fees?
cta.paragraph: Experience blockchain transactions without the financial uncertainty.
